OFFER OF EMPLOYMENT

Brightfield Analytics S.L.
Avenida de Aragón 30, 46021 Valencia

Valencia, 20 January 2026

Dear Andrei,

We are pleased to offer you the position of Senior Frontend Engineer in our Product Platform team, reporting to Clara Ibáñez, Head of Engineering.

START DATE AND PLACE OF WORK

Your employment will begin on Monday 2 March 2026. The role is hybrid: you are expected in our Valencia office on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and may work from home on the other days.

SALARY AND BENEFITS

Your gross annual salary will be 62,000 euros, paid in 14 instalments: twelve monthly payments and two extra payments in June and December.

You will also receive private health insurance for yourself and your spouse, a meal allowance of 11 euros per working day, and an annual training budget of 1,200 euros for courses, books and conferences.

PROBATION PERIOD

The first six months are a probation period, during which either party may end the contract without notice.

WORKING HOURS AND HOLIDAYS

The working week is 38 hours, with flexible start between 8:00 and 10:00. You are entitled to 23 working days of paid holiday per year, in addition to public holidays. Holidays not taken by 31 March of the following year are lost.

NOTICE PERIOD

After the probation period, you must give 30 days' written notice if you decide to leave. The company will give you the notice set out in the applicable collective agreement.

EQUIPMENT

You will receive a laptop of your choice (up to 2,500 euros) and a monitor. Equipment remains company property and must be returned when the employment ends.

Please confirm your acceptance by signing and returning this letter by 31 January 2026.

Kind regards,
Clara Ibáñez
Head of Engineering
